name: useDirection
description: A hook for managing text direction (LTR/RTL) with automatic DOM attribute updates for internationalization support.
usage_guidelines: Use for implementing RTL language support.
Syncs with theme store for persistence.
Essential for Arabic, Hebrew, and other RTL languages.
Use in layout components for direction-aware styling.

return_value.description: Tuple with current direction and setter function.

Dont: Don't forget to test RTL layouts
Don't assume LTR for all users
